description: This Swift source file defines a utility enum `GatewaySettingsStore` responsible for managing gateway configuration and state persistence within the application. It includes methods for saving, loading, and clearing various gateway-related data such as IDs, tokens, and connection info, primarily using Keychain and UserDefaults. It also contains a `GatewayDiagnostics` class for logging diagnostics information and handling log files.
